data.name: Achievement Tracker
data.description:
Shows progress toward several in game achievements. Currently only includes the achievements that take longer to achieve, like digging 1,000 holes, or finding all collectables. 

Press F6 to bring up in game, and press again to close. Values do not update in real time, to see progress, close and re-open the menu.

Currently tracks:
NEVER GOING HOME (and thus also THIS PLACE ISN'T SO BAD, WHAT COULD GO WRONG, SURVIVOR)
THIS CAN'T BE HEALTHY
FOODIE
CITY PLANNER (and thus also ARCHITECT, CONTRACTOR and TRADESMAN)
I LIKE BLISTERS (and thus also BADGER)
COLLECTOR
FASHIONISTA
THE 1%
OOOH SHINY
GUMSHOE
INTERIOR DESIGNER
CHIVALRY IS NOT DEAD
SUCKER FOR PUNISHMENT
MC CRAFTY
MAKER
BLOCKBUSTER
I DREAM OF SUSHI

versions.changelog: Added a Hide completed achievements checkbox to the UI.

Add dark background behind the achievement window
Completed achievement lists no longer display unnecessary Complete lines

Added support For MC CRAFTY, MAKER, BLOCKBUSTER and I DREAM OF SUSHI. 
Fixed Virginia Affinity tracking
